### NetworkIsolationLevel

_Underlying type:_ _string_

NetworkIsolationLevel defines the high-level isolation preset.

_Validation:_
- Enum: [HardPerimeter DefaultDenyAll PermissiveDev]

_Appears in:_
- [NetworkProfileSpec](#networkprofilespec)

| Field | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| `HardPerimeter` | IsolationHardPerimeter isolates internal cluster subnets and cloud metadata while permitting egress proxying.<br /> |
| `DefaultDenyAll` | IsolationDefaultDenyAll blocks all outbound network traffic by default.<br /> |
| `PermissiveDev` | IsolationPermissiveDev allows standard developer networking without egress restrictions.<br /> |

### SandboxLeasePhase

_Underlying type:_ _string_

SandboxLeasePhase represents the current phase of a sandbox lease.

_Validation:_
- Enum: [Pending Bound Released Expired Failed]

_Appears in:_
- [SandboxLeaseStatus](#sandboxleasestatus)

| Field | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| `Pending` | SandboxLeasePhasePending indicates the lease is awaiting an available warm sandbox runner.<br /> |
| `Bound` | SandboxLeasePhaseBound indicates the lease is actively bound to a healthy sandbox runner.<br /> |
| `Released` | SandboxLeasePhaseReleased indicates the lease was voluntarily released by the client.<br /> |
| `Expired` | SandboxLeasePhaseExpired indicates the lease timed out before being released.<br /> |
| `Failed` | SandboxLeasePhaseFailed indicates the lease failed to bind or encountered a terminal error.<br /> |

- [SandboxStatus](#sandboxstatus)

| :--- | :--- |
